title: centaurea stenolepis subsp. bosniaca
intro: Centaurea stenolepis subsp. bosniaca, commonly known as  a rare subspecies of the knapweed plant, is a type of flowering plant native to Bosnia and Herzegovina. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various ailments such as fever, sore throats, and digestive issues. Its therapeutic actions include analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-hemorrhagic effects, as well as the ability to protect against oxidative stress and cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Centaurea stenolepis subsp. bosniaca include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being researched for their potential applications in the development of new medicines.
